title: Anyone who has been following me for a while knows that Harmony was m...
transcript: It was just announced that the new musical, harmony, will unfortunately be closing on February 4th. And to be honest, I'm really bummed that the show couldn't find an audience, because I really liked it. I got to see it off Broadway and really enjoyed it. And then I saw it again on Broadway and liked it even more. If you have not seen harmony, this is your sign to go see harmony. You have about three more weeks left to catch it on Broadway, and I promise you, you will not regret it.
